subject: Vendor intake: onboarding milestones & PO routing checkpoints
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@orchardhealth.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T14:08:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor intake: onboarding milestones & PO routing checkpoints

Hi Samir — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same checklist before we loop finance/procurement: 

Call recap (30 min):
- Use case: embed Redwood inference for patient-facing summarization and internal search; expected initial throughput ~50 concurrent requests, peak bursts to 200.
- Key decision criteria you mentioned: security controls (SOC2+/ISO where applicable), predictable unit cost, and PO/contract simplicity for pilot.

Stakeholder map (please confirm):
- Economic buyer: Samir Desai (VP Product) — decision authority on vendor selection and budget.
- Security reviewer: Lina Gomez (InfoSec) — will validate SOC2 evidence and network connectivity.
- Procurement / AP: Patricia Owens / Procurement Ops — handles vendor intake, PO issuance, invoicing cadence.

Ask / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the names/emails and the PO owner for contract routing?
2) I attached our vendor-intake-form.xlsx — can you push that to your procurement team or let us know if they have a template?
3) If security needs a copy of our SOC2 and security questionnaire, we can send orchard-security-questionnaire.pdf and an engineer for a short walkthrough.
4) Target timeline: you mentioned wanting a pilot in Q3. If procurement is OK with a 4–8 week onboarding window, we can target a July pilot start.

Attachments: vendor-intake-form.xlsx

If that all looks right, I’ll loop Laura to start SoW draft and Ben for commercial terms.

Thanks,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
n: +1 415-555-0123
redwood.com

From: Samir Desai <samir@orchardhealth.io>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@orchardhealth.io>, Patricia Owens <patricia.owens@orchardhealth.io>, Procurement Ops <procure@orchardhealth.io>
Date: 2027-06-21T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: onboarding milestones & PO routing checkpoints

Nikhil — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming stakeholders and initial constraints below: 

Confirmed stakeholders: 
- Economic buyer: Samir Desai (samir@orchardhealth.io) — I own the pilot budget and will approve PO up to pilot scope.
- Security contact: Lina Gomez (lina.gomez@orchardhealth.io) — will evaluate SOC2 report and require a short questionnaire answered (we attached as "security intake").
- Procurement / AP: Patricia Owens (patricia.owens@orchardhealth.io) — owns vendor onboarding and PO issuance.

Procurement checklist (high level):
- Vendor portal enrollment (Procurement team will send an invite).
- Completed W-9 and supplier tax docs.
- SOC2 report + completed security questionnaire (Lina will review).
- Certificate of insurance (if applicable).

Invoice/PO notes: 
- Our AP runs net30; we require invoice to reference PO number.
- Remit to: Orchard Health, Inc., Attn: AP — remit@orchardhealth.io (we’ll confirm exact address after portal enrollment).

Timeline:
- Procurement estimates 4–8 weeks to fully onboard a new vendor end-to-end. If we can get intake materials this week, Patricia said she’ll prioritize the portal invite.

I’ll ask Patricia to reply with any vendor portal links and specific fields. Lina — can you confirm if you want a short tech call (30 min) to review network/isolations?

Best,
Samir
VP, Product | Orchard Health

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@orchardhealth.io>
Cc: Patricia Owens <patricia.owens@orchardhealth.io>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@orchardhealth.io>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-22T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: onboarding milestones & PO routing checkpoints

Thanks Samir — appreciate the fast turnaround. A couple practical items from our side: 

1) I’ve attached a short SoW template (redwood-sow-template.pdf) that we typically use for pilot engagements — lightweight, clarifies acceptance criteria and success metrics. If you prefer, we can convert to your template.
2) We’ll prepare the SOC2 report + completed security questionnaire and send to Lina. If Lina wants an engineer Q&A, we can schedule a 30-min session next week.
3) Procurement: once Patricia confirms the portal link and required fields, we’ll complete vendor enrollment and upload W-9 + insurance.
4) Commercial suggestion: to unblock the pilot quickly, would Orchard consider a short pilot PO (3 months, capped spend) to validate integration before full contract? That typically shortens procurement objections.

Action items I’ll take this week:
- Draft pilot SoW and share a DocuSign link for signature (unless you prefer an internal PO-first flow): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234
- Prepare SOC2 + security questionnaire (orchard-security-questionnaire.pdf) for Lina.

Attachments: redwood-sow-template.pdf

Laura Bennett
Director, Solutions | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Patricia Owens <patricia.owens@orchardhealth.io>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procure@orchardhealth.io>, Lina Gomez <lina.gomez@orchardhealth.io>
Date: 2027-06-23T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor intake: onboarding milestones & PO routing checkpoints

Hi all — I own vendor onboarding for Orchard. Quick vendor intake steps and what we need from Redwood to move forward: 

Vendor onboarding checklist (required):
- Completed vendor portal enrollment (we will send an e-invite to the main vendor email once we confirm the legal entity).
- Upload W-9 / tax forms (PDF).
- SOC2 report + completed security questionnaire (we need both PDF and a point-of-contact for follow-up).
- Certificate of insurance (if higher than $1m we may require specific endorsements).
- Bank ACH details for vendor payments (we verify via micro-deposit).

Procurement timing & PO details: 
- Typical time to onboard a vendor fully: 4–8 weeks after we receive complete documentation. Partial pilot access can be faster if legal accepts a pilot SoW + short-term PO.
- Invoices must reference PO number and be submitted to remit@orchardhealth.io. AP processes net30 from invoice receipt and PO.
- Remit/Payable address and AP contact will be shared in the vendor portal invite.

Portal & contract links:
- Vendor portal (invite will come from procure@orchardhealth.io).
- Please include your Redwood legal entity name exactly as registered and your tax ID when completing the portal.

If you send the intake package today we’ll prioritize the portal invite. Once we have the portal completed, I’ll provide the PO number when PR is approved.

Attachments requested back to Orchard: orchard-security-questionnaire.pdf, W-9, SOC2 report.

Patricia Owens
Procurement Director | Orchard Health
patricia.owens@orchardhealth.io
